title: Dead End City — military combat, Apache and RPG-7
introduction: Native before/after model screenshots, weapon launches and the military-base combat performance replay. The last view shows the final wrapped desktop weapon HUD. Each image retains its source artifact and staging receipt; normal HUD remains visible. Software profiling counters do not represent hardware FPS. Earlier airport, vehicle and mission reviews remain linked below.

comparisons.title: Downloaded AH-64 Apache
comparisons.description: Andrew Swihart’s source aircraft replaces the procedural model. All 220,711 authored aircraft near triangles and source materials remain, with measured rotor, gun and payload pivots. Matched parked inspection camera; ordinary UI and world activity can differ.

comparisons.title: Downloaded RPG-7 held by the player
comparisons.description: Polyte’s 3,500-triangle source replaces the oversized procedural launcher. Real-size tube, scope, trigger guard, wooden grips and rear venturi; the hands use measured source grip positions. Same quarter chase view and 13:00 lighting.

comparisons.title: Heavy Fort Sentinel combat
comparisons.description: Same named fight inputs and seed, three burning vehicles and active gunfire. Sampled warm vehicle rendering averaged 20.75 ms before and 11.32 ms after; final particle rectangles omit about 39% of projected area. This is a noisy software-renderer work comparison, not a hardware FPS benchmark. The on-screen FPS chip includes batched profiling waits.

screenshots.title: Apache takeoff under fire
screenshots.description: The actual Fort pad has no reported hull, rotor, building or neighbor contacts. Five seconds on default Climb reached 43.8 m; garrison bullets caused the documented 23 HP loss.

screenshots.title: Q selects rocket pods
screenshots.description: Physical Q and remapped U were checked. Physical Fire launches a four-round ripple; the selected HUD shows actual rocket stock and cooldown, and staged vehicle damage uses normal combat paths.

screenshots.title: Hellfire lock and launch
screenshots.description: A real guided launch consumes one of eight anti-armour missiles and damages the locked tank. Full weapon status expands through the normal weapon chip; Stinger air lock and target damage are separately recorded in the audit.

screenshots.title: RPG firing
screenshots.description: Physical F consumed the loaded round. The actual hero batch contains the complete downloaded near model; projectile and blast behavior keep their existing gameplay rules.

screenshots.title: RPG reload pose
screenshots.description: Existing shoulder, recoil and reload animation uses the downloaded model and measured grip positions. The native reload restored one round and consumed one reserve.

screenshots.title: Readable missile readiness
screenshots.description: Final published package: long weapon names and lock/cooldown status wrap within the normal Apache chip. Its compact and expanded states are measured against the actual viewport.
